input.title: Give the newsletter email input an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale:
The input #news-email has no accessible name. A visible <label>Email address</label> sits just before it, but the label has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the input, so the two aren't connected. I can only edit the element at this offset, so this patch adds aria-label="Email address" to the input. That uses the same words as the visible label, so screen reader users and voice control users get the name they'd expect.

A better fix in the source would be to add for="news-email" to the <label> on line 11. That links the two directly, and clicking the label would then move focus into the field. If you make that change, the aria-label becomes unnecessary and can be removed. This patch fixes the missing name, but it hasn't been tested with assistive technology.
